mapper.select: select notice_no , notice_title , notice_writer , notice_count , notice_regdate , notice_updateDate , isFixed from tbl_notice where useYn = '1'
select * from tbl_notice order by notice_count desc LIMIT 6
SELECT notice_no , notice_title FROM tbl_notice WHERE notice_no < #{notice_no} ORDER BY notice_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT notice_no , notice_title FROM tbl_notice WHERE notice_no > #{notice_no} ORDER BY notice_no LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN notice_regdate >= CURDATE() AND notice_regdate < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN notice_no END) AS dayCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN notice_regdate >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND notice_regdate < CURDATE() THEN notice_no END) AS weekCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN notice_regdate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND notice_regdate < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') THEN notice_no END) AS monthCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN YEAR(notice_regdate) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND notice_regdate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-01-01') AND notice_regdate < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 YEAR, '%Y-01-01') THEN notice_no END) AS yearCnt FROM tbl_notice
